items.name: theme
items.title: ikada theme
items.description: ikada's tokens for Tailwind v4: OKLCH colours for light and dark, an ikada-scoped type scale (text-sb-*), radii, shadows, motion springs, layers and density. Light by default, dark with a .dark class.

theme.font-mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

items.docs: Light is the default; add class="dark" to <html> for dark (next-themes: attribute="class"). Load Figtree and JetBrains Mono if you want ikada's faces (otherwise the system faces are used). ikada never redefines Tailwind's text-* scale: its sizes are text-sb-*.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's picture with their initial when there is none (or it fails to load).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status or label in a soft tinted pill.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: An inline notice about the page it sits on: a deploy is blocked, a quota is near.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A breadcrumb trail for the org, project and environment you are in, collapsing on narrow screens.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The action control: primary (green, one per view), secondary, ghost and danger, in three sizes.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A yes/no choice for forms, with a checked, unchecked and indeterminate state and a springy tick.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A monospace block for commands and output, with a copy button.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Global search and jump on Cmd or Ctrl K: grouped results, prefix filters and keyboard navigation.
items.docs: Mount it once in your layout and open it with useCommandPaletteShortcut().

items.name: copy-id
items.title: Copy Id
items.description: An ID or token in a mono well with a copy button; "Copied" confirms in place, never as a toast.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Term and details pairs: an account, a deployment.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with title, description and actions; a click opens it with a spring, a key press opens it instantly.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that opens from a trigger.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What an empty list or page says: a title, one line on what goes here, and one action.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A form control with its label, hint and error, wired together for screen readers.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A Button that shows only an icon, with a required accessible label and a tooltip-ready target.

items.name: inline-confirm
items.title: Inline Confirm
items.description: Feedback next to the control that was used, not in the corner: Copied, Saved.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field: a well with the control edge as an inset ring, and the focus wake.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keycap for shortcut hints, such as the K in Cmd K.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label that pairs with Input, Select and the other controls, with a required marker.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: An inline link with an underline that follows the text colour; renders any element through the render prop.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A labelled bar for a bounded measurement, with normal, warning and danger tones and a usage variant.

items.name: metric-tile
items.title: Metric Tile
items.description: One headline number with its unit, change and trend.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The title row of a page: breadcrumbs, title, status, actions and optional page tabs.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous, next and numbered pages for a long list, with gaps past the neighbours of the current page.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Interactive content anchored to a trigger, such as a small form.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice out of a few, all visible at once, with keyboard arrows and a springy dot.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: One choice out of a few, always one selected (a click on the selected segment does nothing).

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one value from a list that opens like a menu.

items.name: sensitive-input
items.title: Sensitive Input
items.description: A password or token field: masked by default, with a button that reveals it and an optional one that copies it.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The account navigation: a collapsible rail on desktop and a drawer on mobile, with grouped items and a footer.
items.docs: Wrap the app shell in the sidebar's state hook as shown in the docs; on mobile it becomes a drawer.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Decorative placeholder (a fade, so it stays under reduced motion).

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A turning ring for pending work, in three sizes; it stays still under reduced motion.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A status shape with its label, for lists and headers.

items.name: status-glyph
items.title: Status Glyph
items.description: A 10px shape per status (circle, bullseye for live, triangle, cross, half ring, square).

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: The status vocabulary (live, building, failed, paused and others) shared by Badge, StatusDot and Toast.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies at once, with a label slot and a thumb that settles on a spring.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A semantic table in a scroll container, with sortable headers, loading, empty and error rows.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of one subject in place.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field in the Input's surface, wired into Field like Input is.

items.name: toast-api
items.title: Toast API
items.description: The toast store behind the toast component: toast(), success and error helpers, undo, merging repeats and mutable deploy toasts.
items.docs: Mount <ToastProvider> from the toast item once near the root; toast() works from anywhere after that.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts as a deck at the bottom end: hover or focus fans out the history, ↩ undoes (⌘Z), a flick dismisses.
items.docs: Mount <ToastProvider> once near the root of your app (and <TooltipProvider> for tooltips), then call toast() from anywhere.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short plain-text label on hover or focus, after a delay.
items.docs: Wrap your app (or the part that uses tooltips) in <TooltipProvider> once.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A 44px trend line with no axes, a dot on the current point, a hover value and the same tokens as TimeseriesChart.
items.docs: Uses @tanstack/charts (installed with this item). Load it lazily where the chart is below the fold.

items.name: chart-theme
items.title: Chart theme
items.description: Chart colour tokens as CSS variable references, so TanStack Charts follow light and dark.

items.name: timeseries-chart
items.title: Timeseries Chart
items.description: A line (and optional area) chart on TanStack Charts, themed by the chart tokens: grid and tooltip follow light and dark, and the deploy marker is a dashed rule so a before and after read at a glance.
items.docs: Uses @tanstack/charts (installed with this item). Load it lazily in routes that show charts, for example with React.lazy or next/dynamic.

items.name: tooltip-card
items.title: Chart tooltip card
items.description: Builds the hover card (a title over swatch rows) that Sparkline and TimeseriesChart share.

items.name: accessible-name
items.title: Accessible name
items.description: The aria-label or deprecated ariaLabel prop type that the chart components share.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn and style primitives
items.description: ikada's class helper (clsx plus tailwind-merge that understands the text-sb-* sizes) and the shared style primitives: focus ring, press motion, popup motion and field surfaces. Installs to components/ikada/lib, never to lib/utils.

items.name: crossfade
items.title: Crossfade
items.description: Crossfades between versions of its content: the old layer blurs out while the new one blurs in (the blur hides that two different things overlap), and for text the box animates to the new height, for inline content to the new width.

items.name: format
items.title: Format
items.description: Number and byte formatting shared by every ikada component: compact, grouped and locale-aware.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The ikada icon set: 16px line icons on a 1.6px stroke that inherit the text colour.

items.name: instant
items.title: Instant
items.description: Keyboard-opened overlays do not animate: they answer a deliberate key press and are opened constantly.

items.name: locale
items.title: Locale
items.description: The number and date locale for a subtree, with `en` as the default.

items.name: portal
items.title: Portal
items.description: Where floating layers mount, so menus and dialogs can sit inside a themed container.

items.name: spring
items.title: Spring
items.description: A damped spring as a CSS `linear()` easing, described the way Apple's HIG does: a perceived `seconds` and a `bounce` (0 is critically damped, 0.25 overshoots once).

items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: ikada's design tokens as typed data: colours, type, spacing, radii, shadows, motion, springs and layers.

items.name: d1-console
items.title: D1 console
items.description: A SQL console for a D1 database: the tables and their columns, an editor that runs with ⌘↵, and the result grid with its row count and timing.

items.name: empty-states
items.title: Empty states
items.description: The four things an empty view can mean, each with one way forward: nothing created yet, nothing matching a filter, nothing deployed, and a load that failed with a retry.

items.name: kv-browser
items.title: KV browser
items.description: A KV namespace's keys, filtered by prefix or search, beside the selected key's value, metadata and expiry, with copy and a two-step delete that can be undone.

items.name: logs-panel
items.title: Logs panel
items.description: A live log tail with level and source filter chips, search, and a Live or Paused stream that holds still while the pointer rests on it.

items.name: metric-row
items.title: Metric row
items.description: A row of headline numbers for the last 24 hours: requests, error rate, response time and sprouts serving, each with its change and an hourly sparkline.

items.name: project-tray
items.title: Project tray
items.description: A recessed tray per project holding its sprouts as floating cards: each card has a status tile, the hostname and one state line, and an empty project offers to plant its first sprout.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings section
items.description: Settings as titled cards: fields, switches that read as sentences, a choice of retention, a save bar that floats up once something changed, and a danger zone that confirms a delete in place.

items.name: sign-in-card
items.title: Sign-in card
items.description: One card for getting in: email a sign-in link or continue with GitHub, then a check-your-inbox state; in waitlist mode, a short join form whose confirmation sprouts.

items.name: toast-deck
items.title: Toast deck
items.description: Toasts in practice: a revoke that removes the row at once and offers Undo (also ⌘Z), a deploy that morphs one toast from Uploaded to Live or to a failure with Retry, and the history feed.

items.name: traffic-chart
items.title: Traffic chart
items.description: Requests and 5xx errors over time with deploys marked as dashed rules, a range switch (hour, day, week), the range's totals and a legend that names every line, so colour is never the only key.

items.name: usage-line
items.title: Usage line
items.description: Today's quotas in one quiet row, each a figure and a small meter that turns amber near its limit, with the plan and reset time at the end.

items.name: all
items.title: All ikada components
items.description: Every ikada component, its helpers and the theme, installed under components/ikada.
items.docs: Components install to components/ikada/ and never overwrite your own button.tsx, input.tsx and the rest. Import them from "@/components/ikada/<name>". Add class="dark" to <html> for dark mode.
